draft_en.subject: The PoE switches you bundle under your own label - 8-port managed and budget 8/16
draft_en.body:
Hello OVISS team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 4 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE switches you bundle under your own label with camera systems, in your packaging from small lots, FCC/CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $87.4 USD EXW with your logo (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); budget unmanaged 8 x PoE+ + 2 x Gigabit - STC-028GP - $27.2; 16 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed - STC-2216GPM - $153.5. Logo on the unit is free; colour box from 200 sets.

One question: which port count do your installers order most with the cameras - 8 or 16?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
